biggest_catch: Austin-only and actively excludes co-op and master-metered accounts — you must be a direct Austin Energy residential customer with an eligible thermostat. The $75 posts to your electric bill, not as cash.
catches: Must be an Austin Energy residential customer; co-op and master-metered accounts are excluded.
Requires an eligible smart thermostat on central AC.
The $75 enrollment incentive and $30 annual credit are bill credits, not cash.
A separate $50 purchase/install rebate exists (claim within 90 days of installation) — different route, don't confuse the two.
Annual credits assume continued participation; terms confirmed via the March 2026 incentive announcement.

steps: Confirm you're an active Austin Energy residential customer (not co-op or master-metered) with an eligible smart thermostat.
Enroll your thermostat in the Power Partner Thermostat program on the Austin Energy page.
Allow small automatic adjustments during peak events (you can usually override them).
Stay enrolled to earn $30 annually per thermostat. (If you just bought the thermostat, claim the separate $50 install rebate within 90 days.)
timing: Enrollment bill credit on sign-up; $30 annual credit while enrolled.
